ecosystem_modules.title: Hub and repository operations
ecosystem_modules.objective: Models, datasets, Spaces, collections, organizations, revisions, branches, commits, CLI, API and Xet.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Create a versioned model/dataset/Space project with metadata and immutable revision references.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Model cards, dataset cards and governance
ecosystem_modules.objective: Model/dataset cards, licenses, intended use, limitations, bias, safety, provenance, gated access and security review.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Audit three synthetic repository cards and produce a provenance decision.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Dataset engineering
ecosystem_modules.objective: Load, stream, map, filter, split, deduplicate, curate, version and audit datasets with privacy and licensing controls.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Build a reproducible dataset pipeline with isolated train/validation/test/private holdout.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Spaces and ML application delivery
ecosystem_modules.objective: Gradio/Streamlit SDKs, app configuration, secrets, hardware, ZeroGPU concepts, logs, builds and rollback.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Build a local demo and deployment plan with secrets excluded from source.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Transformers and model execution
ecosystem_modules.objective: Configs, tokenizers, processors, model heads, generation, pipelines, Trainer, inference and model compatibility.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Run a local small model task and test schema, memory and output correctness.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Tokenizers and text representation
ecosystem_modules.objective: Normalization, pre-tokenization, BPE, WordPiece, Unigram, byte-level tokenization, vocabulary and alignment.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Train a rights-cleared tokenizer and test Unicode, code, multilingual coverage and round-trip.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Accelerate and distributed training
ecosystem_modules.objective: Device maps, mixed precision, multi-GPU, distributed execution, gradient accumulation and CPU fallback.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Design a reproducible hardware-aware training launch plan; no compute starts without approval.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: PEFT and efficient fine-tuning
ecosystem_modules.objective: LoRA, adapters, prompt tuning, QLoRA, trainable parameter scopes and checkpoint comparison.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Fine-tuning plan with frozen weights, trainable-parameter manifest and rollback.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: TRL and post-training
ecosystem_modules.objective: SFT, preference data, reward models, DPO, GRPO, PPO concepts, distillation and post-training evaluation.
ecosystem_modules.practice: Build a toy reward pipeline and adversarial reward-hacking test.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

ecosystem_modules.title: Diffusers and generative media

ecosystem_modules.practice: Create original synthetic media fixtures and compare quality/safety metrics.
ecosystem_modules.assessment: Complete an original hands-on lab, safety and provenance review, independent task and regression benchmark.

refresh_policy: Re-scan the official Hugging Face Learn page and documentation index each release; add, retire or flag courses as the upstream catalog changes.
rights_policy: Links and course metadata do not grant transcript, media, redistribution or model-training permission. Use the official course licenses where explicitly stated; review each asset before reuse.
caveats: Deep RL Course is marked low-maintenance by its own introduction; some AI-vs-AI challenge and leaderboard features are no longer operational.
A course appearing in the official catalog does not prove that every linked exercise or external environment remains runnable.
No paid compute or external provider execution is authorized by this curriculum.
mastery: Course completion requires original exercises, evidence, an independent unseen assessment and reviewer approval; reading or metadata ingestion is not mastery.
